selected.rationale: Loss on the synchronous webapp->ordering-api call blocks order placement; the static contract shows no per-request timeout/retry, so the core checkout path suffers unbounded latency and no fallback.
This edge is statically verified to have no timeout/retry; packet loss makes storefront catalog requests hang or fail without degradation or circuit breaker.
The cart/checkout flow depends on basket-api; loss on this synchronous edge is likely to hang cart operations because no gRPC deadline or HTTP timeout is configured.
Mobile order placement uses mobile-bff->ordering-api synchronously; loss blocks checkout and, without a client-side timeout, propagates as an unbounded wait.
Loss on the webapp->rabbitmq publish edge can drop or fail checkout/order integration events; without publisher-confirm/retry this interrupts the order business flow.
Identity/authentication calls from webapp are synchronous; loss causes login to hang or fail and, without an explicit timeout, creates user-blocking latency.
Payment processing depends on paymentprocessor->rabbitmq; loss stalls payment event delivery and can leave orders permanently unpaid if recovery/retry is missing.
Basket state lives in Redis; a loss on basket-api->redis breaks cart read/write, exposing cart unavailability and missing fallback/recovery behavior.
Order DB loss on ordering-api->order-db prevents order read/persistence, making order placement return errors and the ordering API unavailable without retry/circuit protection.
Catalog DB loss makes catalog-api unavailable to all frontends, producing storefront failures and exposing missing resilience/fallback for the catalog state store.
